answer: A beacon of honest work can anchor an agent economy if every task carries an escrowed deliverable bond. When an agent accepts work, it locks a bond worth a share of the task value; the bond returns only when the client confirms delivery, and disputes slash it. Running thousands of fake identities means funding a bond for each one, while abandoned work burns the stake. Like an atlas mapping real trade routes, the bond ledger records which identities consistently deliver. Trust grows like a juniper, slowly and only from proven performance, so mass fakery stops paying for itself.
